description: Source code for handling file uploads, including session management, plugin hooks, file info generation, and image processing in the Mattermost server.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct handling file uploads and sessions.

methods.name: genFileInfoFromReader
methods.description: Generates file metadata including MIME type, size, and image dimensions if applicable.

methods.name: runPluginsHook
methods.description: Executes plugin hooks during file upload, allowing plugins to modify or reject uploads.

methods.name: CreateUploadSession
methods.description: Creates a new upload session with a specific path based on upload type.

methods.name: GetUploadSession
methods.description: Retrieves an existing upload session by ID.

methods.name: GetUploadSessionsForUser
methods.description: Retrieves all upload sessions for a specific user.

methods.name: UploadData
methods.description: Handles uploading chunks of data, manages session locking, and finalizes file info upon completion.
